Datasheets for Datasets (arXiv 1803.09010v8) · paper method: The questions and workflow were refined over roughly two years with multiple rounds of feedback.

candidate.paperfull.datasheets.development-process

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • Subsequent paragraphs describe example datasheets, product teams, researcher/practitioner/policy comments and legal feedback; this is author-reported development, not a controlled effectiveness trial.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Datasheets for Datasets (arXiv 1803.09010v8) · paper method: The paper states that datasheets alone are not a complete mitigation for unwanted societal bias or potential dataset harms.

candidate.paperfull.datasheets.documentation-mitigation-limit

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • Creators cannot anticipate every use, demographic information may be unavailable, and documentation imposes time and organizational overhead.
  • Datasheets for DatasetsLocator: PDF p. 11; 4 Impact and Challenges, paragraph beginning Datasheets for datasets

    do not provide a complete solution

Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model (arXiv 2305.18290v3) · paper method: DPO fits an implicit reward through a direct policy objective without fitting a separate reward model and running an RL training loop.

candidate.paperfull.dpo.direct-policy-objective

  • The equivalence uses the paper’s KL-constrained objective and preference-model assumptions. Preference-labelled pairs are still required.

Toloka’s task guidelines state different conditions for public-space images, third-party personal information, and personal information collected from Tolokers; the third-party rule lists both anonymization before upload and consent agreements.

Scope and reported basis
Evidence scope
primary disclosure; execution not independently audited
Source conditions
  • Personal information collected from tolokers:
    • Lawful collection required: Yes
    • Prohibitions:
      • No media collection to create a database for identity searches
      • No photo collection for prohibited sensitive-attribute biometric categorization systems
    • Required together:
      • Name an actual entity administering collection
      • Specify the collection purpose in the task
      • Link the privacy policy in the task
      • Follow linked Guidelines on data collection
  • Personal information of third parties:
    • Required together:
      • PII anonymized prior to uploading
      • Consent agreements with people whose PII may appear in tasks
  • Public space images:
    • Blur before upload: All people, license plates and other PII; exception for tasks where person or vehicle search is the main purpose
    • If not blurred: Provide consent agreements with people whose images or vehicles may appear
Basis statement
Toloka’s task guidelines state different conditions for public-space images, third-party personal information, and personal information collected from Tolokers; the third-party rule lists both anonymization before upload and consent agreements.
